# m.partners.benzinga.guidance

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Earnings and revenue guidance issued by US companies, as reported by Benzinga.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.partners.benzinga.guidance(symbols=None, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `BenzingaId`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | US stock tickers. Leave it out for every ticker; `dm.ALL` is refused. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any field of the rows, such as `"date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. A watchlist's `fetch()` caps every request instead. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"positioning": "primary"}`. Keys: `date`, `date_any_of`, `date_gt`, `date_gte`, `date_lt`, `date_lte`, `fiscal_period`, `fiscal_period_any_of`, `fiscal_period_gt`, `fiscal_period_gte`, `fiscal_period_lt`, `fiscal_period_lte`, `fiscal_year`, `fiscal_year_any_of`, `fiscal_year_gt`, `fiscal_year_gte`, `fiscal_year_lt`, `fiscal_year_lte`, `importance`, `importance_any_of`, `importance_gt`, `importance_gte`, `importance_lt`, `importance_lte`, `last_updated`, `last_updated_any_of`, `last_updated_gt`, `last_updated_gte`, `last_updated_lt`, `last_updated_lte`, `positioning`, `positioning_any_of`, `positioning_gt`, `positioning_gte`, `positioning_lt`, `positioning_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Corporate Guidance (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Benzinga Corporate Guidance | Updated every 2 hours, All history |
| Benzinga Corporate Guidance Business | Updated every 2 hours, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "The stock symbol of the company issuing guidance." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When `MassiveConfig.unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, such a row fails the table instead, and the column is absent. |
| `BenzingaId` | String | A unique identifier assigned by Benzinga to the guidance record. |
| `CompanyName` | String | The name of the company issuing guidance. |
| `Currency` | String | The ISO 4217 code representing the currency in which the company issued its guidance figures. |
| `Date` | String | The calendar date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) when the guidance was issued. |
| `EpsMethod` | String | The methodology of the EPS figure. Possible values are gaap (standardized financials under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), ffo (Funds From Operations, a non-GAAP metric commonly used to assess the operating performance of REITs), and adj (adjusted, non-GAAP). |
| `EstimatedEpsGuidance` | double | The analyst consensus EPS estimate at the time the company issued its guidance. This can sit above, below, or in line with the company's issued range. |
| `EstimatedRevenueGuidance` | double | The analyst consensus revenue estimate at the time the company issued its guidance. This can sit above, below, or in line with the company's issued range. |
| `FiscalPeriod` | String | The fiscal quarter to which the guidance applies, such as Q1, Q2, Q3, or Q4. |
| `FiscalYear` | long | The fiscal year corresponding to the period for which the guidance is issued. |
| `Importance` | long | A subjective indicator of the importance of the event, on a scale from 0 (lowest) to 5 (highest). |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the record was last updated in the system. |
| `MaxEpsGuidance` | double | The highest EPS value the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. |
| `MaxRevenueGuidance` | double | The highest revenue figure the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. |
| `MinEpsGuidance` | double | The lowest EPS value the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. |
| `MinRevenueGuidance` | double | The lowest revenue figure the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. |
| `Notes` | String | Additional descriptive text or commentary provided about the guidance record. |
| `Positioning` | String | Indicates how a particular guidance value is presented relative to other figures disclosed by the company. Possible values are 'primary' (the emphasized figure) and 'secondary' (a supporting or alternate figure) |
| `PreviousMaxEpsGuidance` | double | The highest EPS value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. |
| `PreviousMaxRevenueGuidance` | double | The highest revenue value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. |
| `PreviousMinEpsGuidance` | double | The lowest EPS value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. |
| `PreviousMinRevenueGuidance` | double | The lowest revenue value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. |
| `ReleaseType` | String | Indicates whether the guidance was issued as part of a scheduled earnings release ('official') or as an unscheduled update ('preliminary'). |
| `RevenueMethod` | String | The methodology of the revenue figure. Possible values are gaap (standardized financials under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) and adj (adjusted, non-GAAP). |
| `Time` | String | The time of day the guidance was announced, in HH:mm:ss format. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
